statement: Show that the vectors $\mathbf{a}=(1,2,3)$, $\mathbf{b}=(2,-1,1)$ and $\mathbf{c}=(4,3,7)$ are coplanar.
solution: The three vectors are coplanar if their scalar triple product $\mathbf{a}\cdot(\mathbf{b}\times\mathbf{c})$ is zero. We have $\mathbf{b}\times\mathbf{c}=(2,-1,1)\times(4,3,7)=(-10,-10,10)$. Then $\mathbf{a}\cdot(\mathbf{b}\times\mathbf{c})=(1,2,3)\cdot(-10,-10,10)=-10-20+30=0$. Hence the vectors are coplanar.
